title: Aligned observation (one row per camera sample time)
description: Gate between raw data and every model. x-role decides which settings may consume a field (configs/inference_settings.yaml); x-derived-from records lineage so that descendants of label fields are refused regardless of their declared role.

time_utc.description: Nominal sample time, UTC. Keyframe capture time for single-frame samples.

utc_offset_min.description: Local standard-time offset of the site (no DST), minutes.

frame_ids.description: Frames (frame.schema.json) entering the sample, all captured within [time_utc - window_s, time_utc].

temp_cond_c.description: Air temperature from the conditioning sensor (cond_sensor_id), averaged over a window ending at time_utc.

pm_dry_ugm3.description: PM measured after a verified dryer (inlet RH logged). Diagnostic E3 anchor only.

road_state.description: Road-surface condition class (dry/moist/wet/...) from a road-weather station.

rh_ref_pct.description: Reference RH over water from ref_sensor_id, averaged over label_window_s centred on time_utc.

temp_ref_c.description: Air temperature of the reference (label) unit; never a feature.

d_censored.description: True: d_ref_k is an upper bound (rh_ref_pct >= instrument censor limit).

pm_raw_ugm3.x-reason: undried optical PM grows hygroscopically with RH: a covert hygrometer

wx_code.x-reason: present-weather codes encode fog/mist/humidity from station sensors

rh_nwp_pct.x-reason: model/reanalysis humidity assimilates the target quantity

^vis_.description: Image-derived features computed from frame_ids only.

^hour_[sc][0-9]+$.description: Fixed Fourier basis of local hour (data-independent, no fitting).

^temp_hist_.description: Causal statistics of temp_cond_c over windows ending at time_utc.

^temp_spl[0-9]+$.description: Fixed-knot cubic B-spline basis of temp_cond_c (data.spline).

^hourxtemp_[sc][0-9]+$.description: Products of the hour Fourier basis with temp_cond_c.

^ctxproj_.description: Cross-fitted E[visual feature | context] (inference.project) built from the context columns of the contrast it enters; SCI context side only.
